steps.label: Reduce
steps.sub: Optionally shrink words to a root

eyebrow: Steps 1 and 2 with the standard library
code:
import re
raw = ("Loved it!!! Battery lasts 2 days..."
       " see https://x.co/a1 :) but the"
       " CHARGER isn't great.")
text = raw.lower()
text = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", " ", text)
text = re.sub(r"[^a-z' ]", " ", text)
tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text)
print(tokens)
caption: Lowercase, drop the URL, keep only letters and apostrophes.
Eleven tokens. The digit 2 is gone, on purpose.

eyebrow: Step 3: stop words, and a trap
code:
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS, CountVectorizer)

len(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)      # 318
"not" in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS  # True

vec = CountVectorizer(stop_words="english")
vec.build_analyzer()("Not a good battery")
# ['good', 'battery']
caption: The stop list deletes 'not'. The meaning flips.
Stems can be non-words. Real stemmers are smarter, not perfect.
